title: AI Scientist v2 — Workshop-Level Autonomous Research

questions.question: Which order does run_one use for a proposed paper?
options: Idea, experiment, retry if needed, polish, writeup, internal review
Idea, writeup, then experiment only if the prose is accepted
Experiment, idea, polish, and no review
Idea, polish, publish immediately, then run a review
questions.explanation: The simulator progresses from idea to experiment and possible recovery, then polish, writeup, and internal review before submission.

questions.question: What happens when an experiment fails and retry recovery also fails?
options: The paper is submitted as polished_but_flawed
run_one abandons it at the experiment stage
The novelty flaw is automatically removed
The writeup stage is skipped but submission continues
questions.explanation: An unrecovered experiment failure returns an Outcome with abandoned_stage='experiment'; later stages are not reached.

questions.question: What does a successful polish step change about an existing novelty or experiment flaw?
options: It deletes the flaw from the experiment record
It converts the flaw into a clean result
It can mark the presentation polished, but the underlying flaw remains
It forces internal review to accept the paper
questions.explanation: polish_masks_weakness affects presentation labels only. polished_but_flawed remains true when either substantive flaw is present.

questions.question: With internal_review_accept=.50, what risk does the simulator illustrate?
options: Every flawed paper is rejected before review
Review acceptance is determined only by novelty_mislabel
A successful review proves the experiment was recovered
A weak review gate can let a polished but flawed paper be submitted
questions.explanation: The reviewer coin flip controls the final gate independently of the flaw flags, so accepted presentation quality is not proof of scientific soundness.

questions.question: When does run_one set polished_ok=True for a submitted paper?
options: Only when novelty and experiment flaws are both absent
Whenever the writeup succeeds, even after a failed experiment
Whenever polish succeeds, regardless of the data
Whenever internal review rejects the paper
questions.explanation: The clean label requires submission plus no novelty flaw and no experiment flaw; polishing alone cannot establish it.

questions.question: If retry_recovery is raised while other probabilities stay fixed, what should the aggregate report generally show?
options: More experiment-stage abandonment, with no possible change in submissions
Fewer unrecovered experiment failures, although recovered failures can still retain an experiment flaw
All novelty flaws disappear
Internal review is bypassed
questions.explanation: A successful retry avoids abandoning at experiment, but the code deliberately keeps a residual experiment flaw on a recovered failure.
